title: TelemetryEvent
description: Shape of one line in .claude/ops/telemetry/events.ndjson, written by lib/telemetry.mjs recordEvent. Deliberately looser than event-record.schema.json (the hash-chained journal entry shape) — telemetry is unordered-safe, unverified timing data, not an audit-chain entry — but still has a minimum required shape rather than being schema-free.
